_about: Store-bought shortcuts for TheMealDB recipes that make their own sauce (or dough). Keyed by TheMealDB's dish name; 'replaces' names that recipe's ingredients exactly, and every ingredient with that name is dropped when the cook takes the shortcut.

Spaghetti Bolognese.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
Spaghetti Bolognese.note: Pour in the jar of pasta sauce where the recipe adds the tomatoes and purée, then simmer as written.

Lasagne.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
Lasagne.note: Pour in the jar of pasta sauce where the recipe adds the tomatoes, purée and honey, then simmer as written.

Fettuccine Alfredo.label: Use jarred Alfredo sauce
Fettuccine Alfredo.note: Warm the jar of Alfredo sauce in the pan and toss it with the cooked fettuccine and parsley.

Chicken Alfredo Primavera.label: Use jarred Alfredo sauce
Chicken Alfredo Primavera.note: Once the vegetables are cooked, stir in the jar of Alfredo sauce instead of the wine, milk, cream and cheese.

Spicy Arrabiata Penne.label: Use jarred arrabbiata sauce
Spicy Arrabiata Penne.note: Cook the garlic in the oil, then pour in the jar of arrabbiata sauce and simmer 5 minutes before tossing with the penne.

Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni.label: Use jarred pasta sauce
Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni.note: Skip making the tomato sauce and spread the jarred pasta sauce under and over the cannelloni.

Sweet and Sour Chicken.label: Use bottled sweet and sour sauce
Sweet and Sour Chicken.note: Pour in about 3/4 cup of the bottled sauce where the recipe adds the pineapple juice mixture.

Sweet and Sour Pork.label: Use bottled sweet and sour sauce
Sweet and Sour Pork.note: Toss the fried pork in about 1/2 cup of the bottled sauce instead of making the sauce.

General Tsos Chicken.label: Use bottled General Tso sauce
General Tsos Chicken.note: Toss the fried chicken in about 3/4 cup of the bottled sauce instead of making the sauce.

Chinese Orange Chicken.label: Use bottled orange sauce
Chinese Orange Chicken.note: Toss the fried chicken in about 3/4 cup of the bottled orange sauce instead of making the sauce.

Teriyaki Chicken Casserole.label: Use bottled teriyaki sauce
Teriyaki Chicken Casserole.note: Thicken about 1 cup of bottled teriyaki sauce with the cornstarch and water instead of making the sauce.

Kung Pao Chicken.label: Use bottled kung pao sauce
Kung Pao Chicken.note: Add about 1/2 cup of the bottled sauce where the recipe adds its sauce.

Katsu Chicken curry.label: Use Japanese curry roux
Katsu Chicken curry.note: Simmer the onions and carrots in the stock, then stir in the curry roux blocks until the sauce thickens.

Honey Teriyaki Salmon.label: Use bottled teriyaki sauce
Honey Teriyaki Salmon.note: Glaze the salmon with about 1/4 cup of bottled teriyaki sauce.

Pizza Express Margherita.label: Use store-bought pizza dough
Pizza Express Margherita.note: Skip making the dough and stretch out the store-bought dough.

Big Mac.label: Use bottled burger sauce
Big Mac.note: Spread bottled burger sauce on the buns instead of mixing the special sauce.

Tandoori chicken.label: Use jarred tandoori paste
Tandoori chicken.note: Mix 1/3 cup of tandoori paste into the yogurt and lemon juice for the marinade.

Crock Pot Chicken Baked Tacos.label: Use a taco seasoning packet
Crock Pot Chicken Baked Tacos.note: Sprinkle the seasoning packet over the chicken instead of the spices.
